_from: docs/plans/stories/PLAN.md. Story paintings for lord: one 1536x864 scene a page, filed as art/story/<story id>-<page>.webp. Matches docs/lord-art style b.

styles.a: Dark gritty painterly medieval fantasy game art, hand-painted oil texture, rich muted earthy colours with warm firelight glow, dramatic cinematic light, a storybook illustration, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no blood, no gore, no romance, no writing, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

pictures.name: lord-opening-1
pictures.prompt: A happy medieval village at night, a hundred warm paper lanterns glowing along the cobbled streets, a bakery with warm light and steam, villagers chatting. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-2
pictures.prompt: A great red dragon swooping over village rooftops at night, carrying sacks of treasure, baskets of bread and strings of lanterns in its claws, villagers hiding. Not scary-gory. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-3
pictures.prompt: The same village in grey dim morning, no lanterns, an empty market with bare stalls, a quiet inn with shutters closed, sad but safe. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-4
pictures.prompt: A very old kind grey-haired village woman holding a big rusty key, opening the heavy wooden door of a dusty stone training hall with weapon racks and old banners inside, light spilling out. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-5
pictures.prompt: A young hero of about ten holding a wooden sword high in the village square, determined and brave, villagers watching hopefully, seen from slightly behind. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: lord-opening-6
pictures.prompt: A winding dirt road leading from a little village through a dark forest towards distant volcanic mountains with a glowing red cave mouth, a small hero walking the road. Landscape, wide.
